roadmap.title: Start of the game: first runs and building unlocks
roadmap.description: Refuse the job offers at the very start until the daughter ends the run, then play normally. Beat the Finance Tower boss twice and unlock the driving school, Fulfillment Center and Night Shift as money allows.

roadmap.title: City map, Cage Fight and Founder story
roadmap.description: Play Night Shift once to start the cutout hunt. Work through the city secrets, Cage Fight, Company History Month, the soup kitchen, the statue song and the credits.

roadmap.title: Foreign Manufacturing and Neurolink
roadmap.description: Win Foreign Manufacturing, then refuse the job offer when first entering Neurolink. Finish Neurolink and hunt the briefcase man with the Student.

roadmap.title: The Founder's bunker
roadmap.description: Choose to take or leave the Founder's wealth, crown and bunker; keep playing after leaving it for the last story achievement.

roadmap.title: Counters, run challenges and long grinds
roadmap.description: Mix the run challenges and counters into normal runs, then farm expansions, money and the online Cage Fight rank.

achievements.displayName: You can't fire me, I quit
achievements.description: Defeat your boss to become your boss
achievements.summary: Beat the first final boss at the top of the Finance Tower.

steps.text: Play runs in the @loc{Finance Tower} until you reach the boss at the top, then defeat him.

achievements.description: Refuse every job offer at the start of the game.
achievements.summary: Refuse every job offer at the start of the game until your daughter ends your run.

guide.context: This only works in the opening of a save. If you accept a job, you need a new save to try again. @warn{Do this before anything else.}

steps.text: When the game offers you a job in the opening, choose no. Keep choosing no each time it asks, until your daughter has had enough and the run ends.

achievements.description: climb 100 ladders
achievements.summary: Climb 100 ladders.

steps.text: Climb ladders and stairs during runs until the counter reaches 100.

achievements.description: Extinguish the fire on a burning coworker
achievements.summary: Put out the fire on a burning coworker with a fire extinguisher.

guide.context: Another route is the Task Dodger: upgrade the Paper Airplane fully to unlock the extinguisher, then douse a coworker who is on fire. A friend with any fire attack helps.

steps.text: In @loc{Cage Fight}, pick the first opponent, the addict CEO. Equip @item{Cigarette toss} and then @item{Fire extinguisher}, in that order. Add @item{Fake handshake} just before the cigarette toss to make it more reliable.
Set the CEO on fire with the cigarette, then use the extinguisher on him.

achievements.description: Perform 100 consecutive punches
achievements.summary: Perform 100 punches in a row without using any other attack.

steps.text: Pick a character that has only punch moves, such as the Weeb with Karate Punch at its maximum level. A fresh save makes this easier.
Punch 100 times in a row. Do not pick up any non-punch move, because any other attack resets the count.

achievements.description: Get your Driver's license
achievements.summary: Get your driver's license.

steps.text: Keep earning money. At a set point a cutscene starts the driving test.
Finish the driving test.

achievements.description: Work a day shift at the Fulfillment Center
achievements.summary: Finish a day-shift run in the Fulfillment Center.

steps.text: Earn money until the @loc{Fulfillment Center} opens.
Play one day-shift run there.

achievements.description: Become listed on the Stockmarket
achievements.summary: Become listed on the stock market.

steps.text: Beat the final boss in the @loc{Finance Tower} a second time.
In the cutscene afterward, press the button the shareholders point to each time.

achievements.displayName: Fight with both hands behind my back
achievements.description: Watch a ranked Cage Fight
achievements.summary: Watch a ranked Cage Fight.

guide.context: If Online is not open yet, beat all six CEOs first (see Forbes 100).

steps.text: Unlock @loc{Cage Fight} and finish its training.
Choose Online and start a fight.

achievements.displayName: We only come out at night
achievements.description: Work the Night Shift
achievements.summary: Work the Night Shift.

steps.text: Earn money until the Night Shift unlocks.
At the @loc{Finance Tower}, choose Night Shift instead of Day Shift and play it with any character.

achievements.description: Evade the police by spraying your whole body a different color
achievements.summary: Evade the police by changing your body color in the repair shop.

steps.text: Get a wanted level, for example by stealing the police car or killing a police officer.
Run into the building at the top-left of the city map, next to the overpass. Your color changes and the police lose you.

achievements.description: Destroy all the wooden CEO cutouts in the city
achievements.summary: Destroy all five wooden CEO cutouts in the city.

guide.context: The cutouts appear after you finish a Night Shift once.

collectibles.name: Cutout 4
collectibles.method: Left of the hospital. A car may be needed to break the fence.

collectibles.name: Cutout 5
collectibles.method: The station grows taller later and can hide this one, so break it early.

achievements.description: Make 1 million dollars
achievements.summary: Make 1 million dollars.

steps.text: Earn cash in runs. @loc{Neurolink} pays best; the @loc{Finance Tower} and @loc{Foreign Manufacturing} also work.

achievements.description: Have 10 Mindpowers at once
achievements.summary: Hold 10 mindpowers at the same time in one run.

steps.text: In @loc{Neurolink}, pick a new mindpower each time you are offered one until you hold 10 different ones.

achievements.description: Fire 100 guns in one run
achievements.summary: Fire 100 guns in one run.

steps.text: Play the Conservative archetype.
Take ammo upgrades so you do not run dry, then fire 100 guns before the run ends.

achievements.description: Perform 100 consecutive kicks
achievements.summary: Perform 100 kicks in a row without using any other attack.

steps.text: Pick a character that only kicks, such as the Jogger.
Kick 100 times in a row. Any other attack resets the count.

achievements.description: Use 100 different moves
achievements.summary: Use 100 different moves.

steps.text: Use as many different moves as you can across your runs. The game gives no clear count, so try new moves often.

achievements.description: Unlock all archetypes
achievements.summary: Unlock every archetype.

guide.context: Ten reps in one run give one body upgrade, so the counters fill over many runs. Saitama is needed for this achievement.

steps.text: Unlock archetypes through runs, expansions and the secret tasks: break the red cutouts and kill three marked CEOs, lasso three criminals and take them to the police, fire the G-Man, and kill the younglings.
Buy the gym in the @loc{Finance Tower}. On the gym mats in day-shift runs, do 100 push-ups, 100 sit-ups and 100 squats in total to unlock Saitama.

achievements.description: Purchase all expansions for all Game Modes
achievements.summary: Buy all expansions for every game mode.

guide.context: Ghosts give only about 2 to 10 per night run, so they take the most runs.

steps.text: Cash: farm the @loc{Neurolink}, @loc{Finance Tower} or @loc{Foreign Manufacturing}.
Sweat: beat sweating coworkers, mostly in the @loc{Fulfillment Center}. Take the extra-sweat upgrade when offered.
Paperclips: open crates in the @loc{Finance Tower} (more at night) and the @loc{Fulfillment Center} once its expansion is bought.
Blood: donate at the nurse rooms in the @loc{Fulfillment Center} after buying that expansion. Expect about three rooms a run.
Ghosts: fire angel coworkers and the ghost that appears after each one. They only show up on the @loc{Finance Tower} night shift, mostly in the first floors.

achievements.description: Kick 1000 coworkers in the balls
achievements.summary: Kick 1000 coworkers in the balls.

steps.text: Kick coworkers in the groin during runs until the counter reaches 1000.

achievements.description: Defeat the final boss of Foreign Manufacturing
achievements.summary: Beat the last boss in Foreign Manufacturing.

steps.text: Win three runs in @loc{Foreign Manufacturing}.
On the fourth run, beat the boss who waits at the very top.

achievements.displayName: You are better than Elon Musk
achievements.description: Defeat the final boss of Neurolink
achievements.summary: Defeat the final boss of Neurolink.

steps.text: Win two runs in @loc{Neurolink}.
On the third run, beat the final boss. He flies with a jetpack and fires missiles and lasers, so take the Broaden your mind range upgrades.

achievements.description: Defenestrate 100 coworkers
achievements.summary: Defenestrate 100 coworkers.

steps.text: Throw coworkers out of windows during runs until the counter reaches 100.

achievements.description: Dismember 1000 coworkers
achievements.summary: Dismember 1000 coworkers.

steps.text: Dismember coworkers in normal runs; custom levels do not count.
For the fastest count, spam slashing attacks in @loc{Foreign Manufacturing} with the Edgelord.

achievements.description: Gentrify 10 times in the City Map
achievements.summary: Gentrify the City Map 10 times.

steps.text: Gentrify on the @loc{City Map} until the counter reaches 10.

achievements.description: Fire the mysterious observer in Neurolink.
achievements.summary: Fire the mysterious observer in Neurolink.

guide.context: He does not appear every run, so repeat runs until he does.

steps.text: Start a @loc{Neurolink} run as the Student.
Check the glass scientist rooms. Look for a third man holding a briefcase and with no lab coat.
Use the Student's teleport to enter that room and fire him quickly, because he walks away soon.

achievements.description: Turn on God mode.
achievements.summary: Turn on God mode.

guide.context: If it does nothing, restart the game and try again.

steps.text: Press Ctrl+Shift+C to enable cheats.
Press Ctrl+Shift+G.

achievements.description: Listen to the whole song at the founder statue
achievements.summary: Let the founder statue's entire song play.

steps.text: Finish the Founder story inside the statue.
Stand by the statue and let the whole song play.

achievements.description: Win a run with a full bladder
achievements.summary: Win a run without using the bathroom.

steps.text: Drink from every water dispenser and coffee machine you pass.
Never use a bathroom stall, then win the run.

achievements.description: Beat the Founder and leave his crown.
achievements.summary: Beat the Founder, then walk away from his money, crown and bunker.

guide.context: @warn{This is the opposite of Look at this Big man.}

steps.text: Beat the Founder in his bunker.
When asked, leave his wealth, crown and bunker alone.

achievements.description: Pour soup on everyone in the soup kitchen
achievements.summary: Pour soup on every person in the soup kitchen.

steps.text: Play the Founder story in the statue until you reach the soup kitchen.
Pour the soup on every person's head.

achievements.description: Return the game to capitalism after dissolving it.
achievements.summary: Keep playing after dissolving capitalism until the game returns to capitalism.

steps.text: After It's finally over, keep playing until the game turns back into a capitalist world.

achievements.description: Beat the Founder and take his crown.
achievements.summary: Beat the Founder, then claim his money, crown and bunker.

guide.context: @warn{This is the opposite of It's finally over.}

steps.text: Beat the Founder in his bunker.
When asked, take his wealth, crown and bunker.

achievements.description: Refuse the job offer when first entering Neurolink.
achievements.summary: Die to your daughter's mind powers on your first visit to Neurolink.

guide.context: @warn{Easy to miss.} If you accept the job, you may need a new save to see the scene again.

steps.text: The first time you enter @loc{Neurolink}, choose no to the job offer.
Keep refusing each time it asks, until your daughter kills you.

achievements.description: Photograph all the webs in the city.
achievements.summary: Photograph all three webs in the city.

guide.context: A present near the entrance to the overpass holds the camera; unlock the Fulfillment Center first.

collectibles.name: Web 1
collectibles.method: Photograph the web on the wall.

collectibles.name: Web 2
collectibles.location: Between the gas station and the Fulfillment Center

achievements.description: Defeat all the CEOs in Cage Fight
achievements.summary: Defeat all six CEOs in Cage Fight.

steps.text: Beat each of the six opponents in @loc{Cage Fight}.

achievements.description: Reach Billionaire Rank in Cage Fight
achievements.summary: Reach Billionaire rank in online Cage Fight.

steps.text: Fight online matches and keep winning until you reach Billionaire rank. A win streak saves a lot of time.

achievements.description: Complete Company History Month
achievements.summary: Complete Company History Month.

steps.text: Unlock Company History Month at the market.
Enter the statue and play the Founder story to the end.

achievements.description: Beat the Credits
achievements.summary: Beat up everyone in the credits.

steps.text: Go to the movie drive-in.
Beat up all the people who appear in the credits.

achievements.description: Kill all the younglings in the city.
achievements.summary: Kill all the younglings in the city.

guide.context: Hurting NPCs puts a bounty on you and the police will come.

steps.text: Look for small NPCs with large heads on the @loc{City Map}, mostly in the south and east. Kill every one of them.
To go faster, raise your wanted level to five stars. A tank appears; steal it and use it on the younglings.
Once the Jedi role unlocks, start a run as the Jedi if the achievement has not already popped.
